## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- calculator tool holder catalog
- treats CAT40 holders as valid for CAT40 Big Plus machines and honors endmill tool filtering
- keeps twin-turret VDI lathes on VDI-compatible turning and live-tool holders
- accepts hyphenated VDI aliases from normalized machine packages
- surfaces CAPTO mill-turn milling-head holders only for milling-head-capable machines
- normalizes BMT45 aliases and keeps BMT boring plus live holders discoverable
